cases.translation: "The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone."
cases.explain: Камень is the subject of стал (became), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Они хотели арестовать его, но побоялись ___.
cases.translation: They wanted to arrest him, but they feared the crowd.
cases.explain: The verb бояться (to fear) governs the genitive → народа.

cases.sentence: Он послал слугу к ___, чтобы тот забрал у них причитающуюся ему часть урожая.
cases.translation: He sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the harvest from them.
cases.explain: К (to) always takes the dative → виноградарям.

cases.sentence: Один человек посадил ___, обнес его забором, выкопал яму для давильни и построил сторожевую башню.
cases.translation: A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower.
cases.explain: Виноградник is the direct object of посадил (planted); it is inanimate, so the accusative matches the nominative.

cases.sentence: И он стал говорить с ними ___.
cases.translation: And he began to speak to them in parables.
cases.explain: Говорить притчами (to speak in parables) uses the instrumental of means → притчами.

cases.sentence: А о том, что мертвые воскресают, разве вы не читали в ___ Моисея, в том месте, где говорится о кусте?
cases.translation: But about the dead being raised, haven't you read in the book of Moses, in the passage about the bush?
cases.explain: В (in) marking a static location takes the prepositional → книге.

reading.ru: Один человек посадил виноградник, обнес его забором, выкопал яму для давильни и построил сторожевую башню.
reading.question: What did the man do to prepare his vineyard, according to the parable?
options: He fenced it, dug a winepress pit, and built a watchtower
He sold it immediately to strangers
He gave it to the poor
reading.correct: He fenced it, dug a winepress pit, and built a watchtower
reading.explain: The man planted the vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a winepress pit, and built a watchtower.

reading.ru: Но виноградари сказали друг другу. «Это наследник. Давайте убьем его, и наследство будет нашим».
reading.question: What did the tenants plan to do when the owner's son arrived?
options: Kill him to seize the inheritance
Welcome him as their new master
reading.correct: Kill him to seize the inheritance
reading.explain: The tenants agreed to kill the heir so the inheritance would be theirs.

reading.ru: Камень, который отвергли строители, стал краеугольным.
reading.question: What does Jesus say happened to the stone the builders rejected?
options: It was thrown into the sea
It was used to build a tower
reading.explain: Quoting Scripture, Jesus says the rejected stone became the cornerstone.

reading.ru: Следует ли платить налог кесарю или нет? Платить нам или не платить?»
reading.question: What trick question did the Pharisees and Herodians ask Jesus about taxes?
options: Whether it is right to pay taxes to Caesar
Whether Caesar should pay taxes to the temple
Whether the poor should be exempt from taxes
reading.correct: Whether it is right to pay taxes to Caesar
reading.explain: They asked Jesus whether it is lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, hoping to trap him.

reading.ru: «Отдавайте Кесарева Кесарю, а Божие — Богу», — сказал Иисус.
reading.question: How did Jesus answer the question about paying taxes?
options: Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's
No one should pay any taxes
All money belongs to the temple
Taxes should be paid only in grain
reading.correct: Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's
reading.explain: Jesus answered, "Give back to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."

reading.ru: Воскресшие из мертвых не будут ни жениться, ни выходить замуж, а будут как ангелы на небесах.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about those raised from the dead?
options: They will be like the angels in heaven and not marry
They will marry the same spouse again
They will remain exactly as they were
reading.correct: They will be like the angels in heaven and not marry
reading.explain: Jesus told the Sadducees that the risen dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage, but will be like the angels in heaven.

reading.ru: «Люби Господа Бога твоего всем сердцем твоим и всей душой твоей, всем разумом твоим и всеми силами твоими».
reading.question: What did Jesus name as the most important commandment?
options: To love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind and strength
To honor your father and mother
To give generously to the poor
reading.correct: To love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind and strength
reading.explain: Jesus named loving God with all one's heart, soul, mind and strength as the greatest commandment.

reading.ru: Вторая заповедь «Люби ближнего твоего, как самого себя».
reading.question: What is the second greatest commandment, according to Jesus?
options: Do not steal from your neighbor
reading.explain: The second commandment Jesus names is to love your neighbor as yourself.

reading.ru: Ведь сам Давид сказал, вдохновляемый Святым Духом, «Сказал Господь Господу моему, сядь по правую руку от меня, пока я не повергну врагов твоих к ногам твоим».
reading.question: What point does Jesus make by quoting David's words about the Lord?
options: David himself called the Christ "Lord", raising the question of how he can be David's son
David predicted the destruction of the temple
David wrote all of the Psalms about Solomon
David refused to acknowledge any messiah
reading.correct: David himself called the Christ "Lord", raising the question of how he can be David's son
reading.explain: Since David himself calls him Lord, Jesus asks how the Christ can also be David's son.

reading.ru: Они разоряют дома вдов и на показ долго молятся. Таких ждет очень суровое наказание.
reading.question: What does Jesus warn about the teachers of the law who devour widows' houses?
options: They will receive a very severe punishment
They will be rewarded for their piety
They will be made high priests
reading.correct: They will receive a very severe punishment
reading.explain: Jesus warns that such men, who devour widows' houses and make a show of long prayers, will receive very severe punishment.

reading.ru: Но вот подошла бедная вдова и бросила две медные монетки.
reading.question: What did the poor widow put into the temple treasury?
reading.explain: The poor widow came and put in two small copper coins.
